artifacts.contract: Typed archetype tables, capacity-admitted migration and explicit row-borrow invalidation; no automatic concurrency or entity-reuse guarantee.
Typed arena HAMT with equality-checked collision buckets, snapshot-preserving update, separately verified deletion and explicit root lifetime/reclamation.
Counted byte rope DAG with immutable roots and explicit capacity/reclamation; text coordinates and editing alternatives require their declared extensions.
Counted byte-only inline16/max128 buffer, allocator injection, strong append failure and explicit move/reset; no arbitrary typed placement or raw-copy ownership guarantee.

PR-T70-02.question: Which inline representation supports the actual capture contract?
PR-T70-02.discriminator: Byte arrays do not establish arbitrary typed object access; self-referential and owning captures require a relocation/ownership rule.
PR-T70-02.reversal_trigger: Payload gains stricter alignment, self pointers or a failing destructor.
